entries.name: The Testerman Family
entries.request: Grieving the loss of Ed's mother this past week. Pray for comfort as the family travels for the service and for peace in the weeks ahead.

entries.name: Dorothy Example
entries.request: Recovering at home after hip replacement surgery. Therapy is going well; she is grateful for every card and asks for continued prayers for patience.

entries.name: Sam Placeholder
entries.request: Beginning a second round of chemotherapy on Monday. Pray for strength, minimal side effects, and calm for his wife and daughters.

entries.name: The Mockingbird Family
entries.request: New job search after a plant closing; two children at home. Pray for provision and a door to open close by.

entries.name: Grace Sampleton
entries.request: Awaiting biopsy results this Thursday. Pray for clear answers and steady hearts whatever the news.

entries.name: Bill and Nancy Fixture
entries.request: Celebrating an answered prayer: Bill's scans came back clear. They give thanks and ask that the list keep praying for the friends they met in treatment.

entries.name: A neighbor on Maxham Road
entries.request: Asked for prayer for her marriage. No details shared; the Lord knows the need.

entries.name: Traveler from Wednesday night
entries.request: Texted asking prayer for safe travel to Fort Benning and a good start in a new post.

entries.name: Flood recovery in the Carolinas
entries.request: For families rebuilding after last month's flooding, and for the volunteer teams our conference is sending this fall.

entries.name: Persecuted churches
entries.request: For congregations who gather at risk, that they would know courage and fellowship.

entries.name: Peace in conflict zones
entries.request: For an end to war, for the protection of civilians, and for the peacemakers.
